_doc.summary: Weights for nimbus.risk. Each feature is normalised to [0,1]; z = bias + sum(weight_i * feature_i); risk_score = 100 / (1 + exp(-z)), rounded to 0.1.
_doc.severity: Scanner severity: CRITICAL=1.0, HIGH=0.75, MEDIUM=0.5, LOW=0.25, INFO=0.
_doc.exposure: 1.0 when the finding carries PUBLIC_NETWORK_EXPOSURE/PUBLIC_DATA_STORE, the resource has an inbound graph edge from the 'internet' node, or attributes mark it internet-exposed.
_doc.identity_risk: Share of {OVERPRIVILEGED_IDENTITY, NO_MFA, CROSS_ACCOUNT_TRUST} present on the finding or its graph node (any one = 0.6, two = 0.85, three = 1).
_doc.data_sensitivity: 1.0 if the graph node is sensitive; 0.8 for DATABASE weakness or datastore class; 0.6 when name/tags hint at pii/prod/customer/payment/secret data.
_doc.criticality: Environment from graph node / tags: production=1.0, staging=0.6, dev=0.3, unknown=0.5.
_doc.compliance_weight: Highest regulatory weight among mapped frameworks: pci_dss/hipaa=1.0, soc2/gdpr=0.8, cis_*/nist/iso=0.6, none=0.3.
_doc.recent_change: 1.0 when the resource was modified in the last 24h (graph node modified_at), decays linearly to 0 at 7 days.
_doc.ownership: 0.7 when the resource has no owner (graph node owner / tags owner|team), else 0.
_doc.attack_path: 0.5*min(1, paths/3) + 0.5*(max path score / max score of all paths); 0 when not on any attack path.
_doc.model: An optional linear model ({"intercept": b, "coefficients": {feature: w}}) in JSON can replace bias/weights (nimbus.risk --model FILE or NIMBUS_RISK_MODEL). Pickle is never loaded.
